description: This file defines a web scraper class 'FlavorsByLinbie' for extracting recipe data from flavorsbylinbie.com, including methods for retrieving author, title, category, total time, ingredients, instructions, description, yields, and related utilities.

classes.name: FlavorsByLinbie
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe information from flavorsbylinbie.com, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname 'flavorsbylinbie.com' for the scraper.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Extracts the recipe author, first trying schema, then HTML author link, and defaulting to site name.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe title from the page's title tag or H1 heading.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Gets the recipe category from schema or meta tag.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates total time from specific H2 heading or paragraph content.

methods.name: _extract_time_from_servings_section
methods.description: Helper to extract prep or cook time from servings section.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Determines recipe yield or servings from paragraph or headings.

methods.name: _get_servings_time_paragraph
methods.description: Retrieves paragraph containing servings and time info.

methods.name: _slice_field
methods.description: Extracts specific field value from paragraph based on label.

methods.name: _normalize_time_phrase
methods.description: Normalizes time phrases for consistent parsing.

methods.name: _extract_time_from_paragraph
methods.description: Parses minutes from paragraph text based on label.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Returns the recipe image URL from schema.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts list of ingredients from 'What You'll Need' section.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Collects step-by-step instructions from the instructions section.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Provides a brief description or summary of the recipe.
